outcome: Build an editable precision outline and use it as an active-layer pixel selection without changing artwork during drafting
provenance: User accepted proposed editable pen/path selection checkpoint on 12-Oct-2026; magnetic selection explicitly follows separately

decisions.interaction: Tap corners; drag a new anchor to create mirrored handles; edit nearest anchor or handle within12 screen pixels; close by first-anchor tap or explicit Close & select
Draft-local toolbar and Ctrl+Z/Shift+Ctrl+Z history; Enter closes; Escape cancels; arrows nudge selected anchor; Delete removes it; contextual Close/Edit/Cancel controls stay on canvas
Exact board/active-layer transient state, prior selection and included-layer scope restored on Cancel; closed region reuses existing actions; board/layer mutations discard stale path

decisions.constraint: 64 anchors/512 samples/.25doc-pixel flatness/50 local history; existing1024 selection and document/render limits
decisions.change_trigger: Measured real-device evidence or explicit larger-capacity checkpoint

input_rules: Palm contact/wheel/concurrent actions cannot move the view during a point drag
Mapped pen buttons cannot overwrite an open draft
Path-only SVG updates reuse the completed artwork frame
visual_direction: Reuse existing panel/button/selection tokens; constant screen-sized anchor/handle targets; landscape and portrait validation
lock: Bounded UX baseline locked from accepted user outcome and current technical constraints; not an independent production approval
